title: RTX ON
description: Add real hardware-accelerated raytracing to Minecraft!
body:
**RTX ON 1.0.0** - Minecraft Raytracing

Turn your vanilla Minecraft 1.21.4 into a stunning cinematic masterpiece with true ray-traced lighting. Powered by **Radiance** + optimized performance mods (Sodium, Lithium, C2ME, ImmediatelyFast & more), enjoy breathtaking global illumination, realistic shadows, reflections, PBR textures, and dynamic lighting.

**Highlights:**
- Gorgeous ray-traced GI, caustics & volumetric effects
- Extreme performance optimizations for smooth gameplay
- Enhanced sound physics with realistic occlusion & reverb
- Entity & block culling, 3D skin layers, and more

Perfect for immersive survival, epic builds, and jaw-dropping screenshots. Light up your blocky world like never before!
